Entry level set at the mean surveyed ground along the road-side face (11.70 m local), interpolated from the survey TIN (inferred).

A full floor below the road-level entry reuses its footprint; the downhill wing steps from that floor toward its own surveyed ground, rather than inheriting the entry bar's terrain offset. The walk-out is a massing intent: exterior doors, terraces, waterproofing, drainage and structural support still need design. There is no excavation-depth limit or preference for minimizing excavation.
